item.title: Genergo: Propellantless space-propulsion system
item.description:
📝 Genergo: an Italian Company Builds the World’s First Known Propellantless Space-propulsion System, Flight-tested and Validated On Orbit 11 Nov Written By Jaime Farr Genergo, an Italian deep-tech company based in Como, comes out of stealth and unveils an innovative electromagnetic space-propulsion system that uses no propellant, successfully flight-tested and validated across three space missions and protected by a portfolio of granted international patents. Genergo’s system generates thrust without using any propellant and without expelling reaction mass, by directly converting electrical energy into thrust through controlled electromagnetic impulses. Genergo’s technology opens new perspectives for space missions.
🔗 Read more: https://www.satcom.digital/news/genergo-an-italian-company-builds-the-worlds-first-known-propellantless-space-propulsion-system-flight-tested-and-validated-on-orbit
